notes.text: _unquote strips a trailing `#` comment before unquoting, but only tracks quote state by toggling on the first quote character it sees and closing on the next matching one - it has no escaping. A `#` inside a properly opened-and-closed quoted value is kept (it never sees a not-in-quotes state to treat it as a comment start), and a value with no `#` at all is untouched either way. What it still gets wrong: a value containing a quoted phrase followed by more unquoted text ending in a stray quote character (no `#` involved) has no single correct split without escaping support - the first and last characters are stripped regardless, moving the true closing delimiter into the middle of the parsed value. Keep quoted string values in sources.yaml free of embedded double quotes, and put an inline `#` note only inside a quoted value if it must survive parsing.
